snippet.title: Panoptic Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Panoptic is available NOW in Steam Early Access at https://store.steampowered.com/app/541930/Panoptic/

Panoptic is a tense, 1v1 asymmetrical VR/desktop game that pits a colossal Overseer, armed with a slow but devastating eye laser, against a tiny dissident Being intent on destroying the Overseer’s energy Orbs by mimicking the movements of others to remain undetected.

Find out more about the game on:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/541930/Panoptic/
Discord : http://discord.gg/6gP6SUU
Twitter : https://twitter.com/panopticvr
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/teampanoptes/
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/PanopticVR/
Our website : http://panopticgame.com/
Or email us at team@panopticgame.com
